entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:1
segments: And it shall be, when you come into the land which the LORD you God gives you for an inheritance, and possess it, and live in it,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:2
segments: you shall take of the first of all the fruit of the earth which you shall bring of your land that the LORD your God gives you, and you shall put [it] in a basket, and shall go to the place which the LORD your God shall choose to place His name there.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:3
segments: And you shall go to the priest in those days, and say to him, I profess today to the LORD your God that I have come into the land which the LORD swore to our fathers to give us.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:4
segments: And the priest shall take the basket out of your hand and set it down before the altar of the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:5
segments: And you shall speak and say before the LORD your God, My father [was] a Syrian ready to perish. And he went down to Egypt, and stayed there with a few, and became there a nation, great, mighty, and many.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:6
segments: And the Egyptians ill-treated us, and afflicted us, and laid hard bondage on us.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:7
segments: And when we cried to the LORD God of our fathers, the LORD heard our voice and looked on our afflictions and our labor and our oppression.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:8
segments: And the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt with a mighty hand, and with an outstretched arm, and with fearful might, and with miracles and with wonders.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:9
segments: And He has brought us into this place, and has given us this land, a land that flows with milk and honey.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:10
segments: And now, behold, I have brought the firstfruits of the land which You, O LORD, have given me. And you shall set it before the LORD your God, and worship before the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:11
segments: And [you shall] rejoice in all the good which the LORD your God has given to you, and to your house; you, and the Levite, and the stranger in your midst.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:12
segments: When you have made an end of tithing all the tithes of your increase the third year, the year of tithing, and have given [it] to the Levite, the stranger, the fatherless, and the widow (that they may eat inside your gates and be filled),

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:13
segments: then you shall say before the LORD your God, I have brought away the holy things out of my house, and also have given them to the Levite, and to the stranger, to the fatherless, and to the widow, according to all Your commandments which You have commanded me. I have not broken Your commandments, neither have I forgotten.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:14
segments: I have not eaten of it in my mourning, neither have I put [any] of it away for unclean [use], nor have I given of it for the dead. I have listened to the voice of the LORD my God, and have done according to all that You have commanded me.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:15
segments: Look down from Your holy dwelling, from Heaven, and bless Your people Israel and the land which You have given us, as You swore to our fathers, a land that flows with milk and honey.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:16
segments: Today the LORD your God has commanded you to do these statutes and judgments. You therefore shall keep and do them with all your heart and with all your soul.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:17
segments: You have today said that the LORD is your God, and that you would walk in His ways, and keep His statutes and His commandments and His judgments, and listen to His voice.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:18
segments: And the LORD has taken you today to be His peculiar people, as He has promised you, and to keep all His commandments,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 26:19
segments: and to make you high above all nations which he has made, in praise and in name and in honor, and that you may be a holy people to the LORD your God, even as He has spoken.
